description.en: The ID of the region where the service is deployed.

Specifies whether to exit development mode. Valid values:

*   true: exits development mode.
*   false (default): enters development mode.

description.zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见[ListServices ](~~412109~~)。
description.en: The service name. For more information about how to query the service name, see [ListServices](~~412109~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eas develop-service --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name echo --exit true --region cn-hangzhou
